title: Coherent adic conditions for direct image with closed ambient support
statement: Let $j:Y\to X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of Noetherian schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth], $K$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on $X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and $F:\mathbb N^{op}\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$ an inverse system [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose $F$ satisfies the coherent formal object conditions for $K\mathcal O_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $T\subseteq X$ be closed and contained in $j(Y)$, and suppose the nonzero-stalk support of every $F_n$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] is contained in $j^{-1}(T)$. Then the actual inverse system $(j_*F_n)$, with the direct images of the given transition maps [def-pc-module-pullback], satisfies the coherent formal object conditions for $K$. No formal-system existence or algebraization conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Theorem Tag 088E, theorem-grothendieck-existence, proof: paragraph after Chow’s lemma, through formation of the extended coherent formal system; Lemma Tag 0CYJ, lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open

proof.text: For each term F_n factor j as its isomorphism onto U = j.opensRange followed by U.ι. Finite coherent pushforward applies to the isomorphism. Transport the closed support hypothesis through that isomorphism using pushforward_support_subset_of_closed_support and the closed preimage of T. Apply pushforward_coherent_on_open on U and transport coherence along pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr. The coherence criterion gives quasi-coherence of every actual j_*F_n.

Let L be tensorPullback j, R be pushforward j, and adj an adjunction L ⊣ R. Since R is fully faithful for an open immersion, its counit at F_n is an isomorphism. Transport the given zero ideal-power product to L(R(F_n)) through this counit, using the existing product-zero-under-monomorphism calculation of CoherentFormalModule. modulePullbackIdealPowerProductImage then says the image of the pulled-back ambient product inclusion is zero. Hence that pulled-back inclusion is zero. The adjunction hom equivalence detects that the original inclusion into R(F_n) is zero; its monicity proves the ambient product object is zero.

Prove directly that the restriction adjunction unit of any X-module supported in T is an isomorphism. On U, restrict further along j.isoOpensRange.inv and use the adjunction triangle with its invertible counit. On T.compl, both the source and the restriction-then-pushforward target have zero sections: sheaf section extensionality and the support hypothesis give zero stalks at every relevant point. The two opens cover X. Transfer restriction isomorphisms through overFunctorEquiv and apply sheaf_module_isIso_iff_isIso_over_open_cover. This whole local argument is proved as a private helper, with no additional hole.

For G = R(F_n) and Q = G/K^mG, the stalk quotient projection is surjective by module_stalk_exact. Thus support(Q) is contained in support(G), hence in T by pushforward_support_subset_of_closed_support. Step 3 makes the restriction unit at Q invertible; uniqueness of left adjoints transports this to the tensor-pullback unit. Reuse the proved private powerQuotientIso and its projection equation from FormalSystemsPullback: L(Q) is the quotient of L(G) by the extended ideal power. Apply the fixed-exponent quotient functor to the invertible counit L(G) ≅ F_n. Composing the unit at Q with the direct image of these two quotient isomorphisms gives Q ≅ R(F_n/(K.comap j)^mF_n). Naturality of the unit, powerQuotientIso_π, quotientMap_π, and the right adjunction triangle prove the equation with the quotient projection. No arbitrary existence witness or new unproved statement enters this construction.

For each n apply step 4 with m = n+1 and the term F_(n+1), then compose the resulting isomorphism with R.mapIso of the given formal-system quotient-to-F_n isomorphism. The projection equation of step 4, functoriality of R, and the given transition equation identify its composite with the actual pushed-forward transition map. Together with steps 1 and 2 this constructs the three conjuncts of IsCoherentFormalModule K (F ⋙ pushforward j) with the original statement unchanged.
